title: MCP guided connect wizard and advanced configuration

steps.label: Review and connect
steps.heading: mcpWizardHeading4
steps.question: is this what I want, and does it answer?

checks.check: connecting a server is four named steps, not one form
the guide asks four questions in order: what, how, what it costs, and is it right
checks.detail: 1 Server · 2 Transport and credentials · 3 Policy and consent · 4 Review and connect

checks.check: one step is on screen at a time, and starting over goes back to the first
checks.detail: mcpWizardGo() hides every other panel; opening the editor resets to step 1

checks.check: the rail says where you are, in a live region, and marks the step it is on
checks.detail: aria-current=step on the current item, done on the ones behind, `Step N of 4 · label` in role=status

checks.check: each step is a labelled group whose heading names the question
checks.detail: role=group, aria-labelledby the step heading, heading focusable for the keyboard

checks.check: no step can advance until it is satisfied, and the refusal is words, not a shake
checks.detail: mcpWizardValidate() returns the sentence, mcpWizardNext() refuses to move while it does

checks.check: a refusal puts the cursor in the field that needs it, and clears when satisfied
checks.detail: mcpWizardProblem() names the reason, focuses the field, and mcpWizardRefresh() clears it

checks.check: Back and Continue are real buttons, and Continue leaves the last step
checks.detail: Back is disabled on step 1; Continue disappears on step 4, where Save & test connection is

checks.check: step 2 shows only the fields the chosen transport needs
checks.detail: toggleMcpTransportFields() shows one block and hides the other

checks.check: the transport says what will happen, in words
checks.detail: a sentence per transport, not a badge or a colour

checks.check: the token is a password field that is never pre-filled or auto-completed
checks.detail: type=password, autocomplete=off, and the editor never writes a stored secret into it

checks.check: raw headers and environment JSON are one closed disclosure, off the guided path
checks.detail: `Advanced: raw headers and environment JSON`, shut, holding both JSON fields

checks.check: the policy step explains what each policy costs
checks.detail: three sentences, one per policy, rendered next to the select

checks.check: a local command needs consent that is given, not implied
checks.detail: the consent row only exists for stdio and mcpWizardValidate(3) refuses until it is ticked

checks.check: the consent names the command it is about
checks.detail: mcpConsentCommand is re-rendered from the exact command and arguments

checks.check: the consent says it cannot grant the operator's permission
checks.detail: the note names the server-side opt-in and disclaims it, so the screen is not mistaken for a gate

checks.check: the review answers what, how, what it costs and whether consent was given
checks.detail: Alias · Display name · Transport · Target · Credential · Approval policy · Local command consent

checks.check: the review never reads the typed token back out
checks.detail: the presence of a typed token is a boolean; its characters are never interpolated

checks.check: a stored token is kept when the field is left blank, and shown only as its mask
checks.detail: unchanged-token semantics: blank means keep, and the mask the server sent is what is named

checks.check: saving re-checks every earlier step, so a field edited after passing it cannot slip through
checks.detail: the guard runs before the POST, not only on the way to it

checks.check: saving says it is testing, then tests in the same request
checks.detail: button label and disabled state restored in `finally`; the POST is the connection test

checks.check: the result is visible where the button is, and says what was found or what failed
checks.detail: ok / failed / testing carried as data-state on a live region inside the last step

checks.check: the confirmation names the tool namespace and offers the server list
checks.detail: a successful test ends with a way to the list, not a dead end

checks.check: the typed secret leaves the field after a save
checks.detail: the field is emptied on success, so the secret does not stay in the page

checks.check: every control the old form had is still in the guide
checks.detail: 20 controls: all present

checks.check: all three approval policies survive inside the guide
checks.detail: auto / inherit / always_ask in the policy select

checks.check: the six MCP routes are unchanged and none were added
checks.detail: 6 routes, no additions

checks.check: consent on the screen does not replace the operator's stdio opt-in
checks.detail: the server still refuses to spawn unless the operator set the variable; the page only records consent

checks.check: the served payload is what masks a secret, not the page
checks.detail: app.py masks on read and keeps a blank token as the stored one

checks.check: a browser walk drives the guide on a screen
checks.detail: mcp_wizard_walk.mjs: 38 recorded checks

checks.check: the walk covers every state the ledger asks for
checks.detail: empty · credentials · policy · review · loading · success · error · recovery · keyboard · long

checks.check: the walk proves the secret never reaches the page, the console or another request
checks.detail: the secret is typed into the form, then searched for in the DOM, the console and every request body

checks.check: captures exist for every viewport and theme, with a before set
checks.detail: 104 after PNG, 104 before PNG

checks.check: the walk can photograph the old one-shot form too
checks.detail: the same instrument runs against the pre-wizard editor to make the before set
